question: Does the paper report the performance of the model for each individual language?
title: X-Stance: A Multilingual Multi-Target Dataset for Stance Detection
answer_rationale: The paper does not report the performance of the model for each individual language; instead, it reports performance across languages collectively, such as in cross-lingual settings, and uses a single multilingual model (M-Bert) trained on multiple languages without language-specific performance breakdowns.
